courses/math-grade-1/u03-2/flag-retrieval.md. Read all three in the five-minute retrieval as separate prompts. If needed, use the assigned five minutes of Practice return to act a fresh arrival. Allow pointing for retell marks.

courses/math-grade-1/u03-2/seal-sequence.md. Model on the practice mat. Rewind to separate the two arrivals from the seven. Trace the remaining group to the covered start. Draw four panels when printing is unavailable.

courses/math-grade-1/u03-2/double-ten-frame.md. Use the shared frame through day 57. From day 58 offer individual copies only. Draw two frames made from two rows of five cells. Keep the frames away from mental observations.

courses/math-grade-1/u03-2/foldable-ten-strip.md. Fold an individual ten-mark strip after matching every mark to one counter. Use the drawing or the strip instead of cubes; withdraw shared towers on day 64.
courses/math-grade-1/u03-2/teen-retrieval.md. Read one prompt at a time. Keep the day 47 marks for day 48 and rebuild a fresh frame before equations if needed.
courses/math-grade-1/u03-2/ten-build-record.md. Draw or assemble only the teacher’s practice numbers. Use loose marks and folded scraps if pieces are unavailable.
courses/math-grade-1/u03-3/packet-practice.md. Model moving loose pieces on open frames while the ten stays. Use no sealed-packet label or crossed-out evidence card here.

courses/math-grade-1/u03-3/removal-practice.md. Model how the leaving group fits the box. Use large paper pins drawn as diamonds, with no sharp objects. Teacher practice key: the missing change is five.
courses/math-grade-1/u03-3/teen-fact-rounds.md. Cover and check with a partner or do individually during observation. These are practice cards. Keep the private mental set folded separately.

courses/math-grade-1/u03-4/three-group-mats.md. Place intact paper shapes or cubes on separate mats, supplied group labels first. Draw these marked spaces with pencil if needed. Use only named practice quantities.

courses/math-grade-1/u03-4/three-trains.md. Day 54 model. Adult prepares detachable groups. Use paper scraps or copied shapes instead of linking cubes. Connect each original group to its term before joining trains.

courses/math-grade-1/u03-4/grouping-layouts.md. Match all three groups across the two supplied arrangements. The last panel compares the two possible starts for subtraction. Keep the counterexample unscored.
courses/math-grade-1/u03-4/split-and-trace.md. Trace the four already marked as moved, then account for the one remaining. Six, four and one make eleven. Change case when retrying.

courses/math-grade-1/u03-5/method-comparison.md. Show the same five round, five square and one long clip across both supplied methods. Invite tracing of each piece and use another case for the fresh return.

courses/math-grade-1/u03-5/three-tag-story.md. Act the scene in order, then pair two with eight. Use fifteen tags in all and preserve all three groups. Patterned scraps or drawn marks substitute for pieces.

courses/math-grade-1/u03-5/transfer-pattern.md. The first group loses one and the next gains one in each row. Only the two groups change, so all totals are nineteen. Keep the exit slide layout separate.

courses/math-grade-1/u03-5/ten-making-rounds.md. Use the familiar try, check and retry routine. Mark the group moved or paired before the partner checks. Read every expression aloud and keep records private.
courses/math-grade-1/u03-5/removal-trace.md. Trace the already separated groups in the model. After one leaves, ten stay. Remove five more and five stay. Do not use the folded exit as practice.
courses/math-grade-1/u03-5/difference-comparison.md. First compare supplied records. Point to the one extra in the start and keep the removal target fixed. Keep S64’s one-fewer panels separate.
courses/math-grade-1/u03-5/count-up-comparison.md. The two supplied methods belong on separate surfaces. Compare the two leftover dots with the two new counts. Use another case for any retry.
courses/math-grade-1/u03-6/story-role-mats.md. Use with one acted practice scene. Supply the labels and ask children to repair a misplaced label. Use large scraps or sketch the pieces.

courses/math-grade-1/u03-6/mixed-arithmetic-cards.md. Independent practice during private observation or familiar puzzles. Offer paper and no-kit drawn pieces; mark after an independent attempt. Keep the private fact cards apart.

courses/math-grade-1/u03-6/story-fragments.md. Use the familiar day 54 picture after the E66 return. Read each supplied fragment and have partners trace it to its pictured group. No story invention during this practice.
